# KayKit Source Archives

Retrieved from the author-published itch.io free tiers on 2026-08-16:

- Adventurers 2.0: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers
- Fantasy Weapons Bits 1.0: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/fantasy-weapons-bits
- Character Animations 1.1: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-character-animations

All three archives declare CC0 1.0 Universal. Original archives and extraction trees are staging
inputs under ignored `assets/incoming/`; `SHA256SUMS` records their immutable identities. Selected
runtime derivatives and their exact conversion commands are documented under `assets/models/`.

Character Animations 1.1 is retained as verified provenance only. No animation-only model is shipped
until the software renderer supports sampling GLTF animation channels.
